title: Mahler coordinates for complete ultrametric coefficient modules
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and let $V$ be a complete normed additive commutative group with a $\mathbf Z_\ell$-module structure, where $\mathbf Z_\ell$ has its inverse-limit topology [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. Assume $\|v+w\|\leq\max(\|v\|,\|w\|)$ and $\|a v\|\leq |a|_\ell\|v\|$ for $a\in\mathbf Z_\ell$. Give $C(\mathbf Z_\ell,V)$ its supremum norm, and put $c_0(\mathbf N,V)=\{(a_n):a_n\to0\}$ with its supremum norm. There is a $\mathbf Z_\ell$-linear isometric equivalence
$$\mathcal M:C(\mathbf Z_\ell,V)\xrightarrow{\sim}c_0(\mathbf N,V),\qquad (\mathcal M f)_n=(\Delta^n f)(0),\quad (\Delta f)(x)=f(x+1)-f(x).$$
